violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. NO CFM OBSERVED ONSITE AT TIME OF INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. PIC ONSITE AT TIME OF INSPECTION PROVIDED EHS WITH PROOF THEY ARE SCHEDULED TO TAKE THE CERTIFICATION EXAM THE SAME DAY AS THE INSPECTION. PLEASE SEND THE EHS PROOF THE CERTIFICATION AS BEEN OBTAINED WITHIN 10 DAYS.

violations.title: (2017) Non-Continuous Cooking Process
violations.observation: The following raw animal foods were not properly cooked using a non-continuous cooking process: OBSERVED SEARED (PARTIALLY COOKED) AHI TUNA IN THE SALAD PREP TOP COOLER.
violations.corrective_action: Raw animal foods that were cooked using a non-continuous cook process shall be subject to an initial heating process that is no longer than 60 minutes in duration; immediately, after initial heating, cooled according to the time and temperature parameters specified for cooked time/temperature control for safety food; after cooling, held frozenor cold; prior to sale or service, cooked using a process that heats all parts of the food to a temperature and for a time as specified under 3-401.11A-C; Cooled according to the time and temperature parameters specified under 3-501.14A if not hot held, served immediately or held using time as a public health control. PLEASE DISCONTINUE PARTIALLY COOKING THE AHI TUNA TO PREVENT FURTHER ENFORCEMENT ACTION. EHS PROVIDED GUIDANCE AND OPTIONS TO THE PIC. PIC DISCARDED OF TUNA DURING INSPECTION.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food items were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED GARLIC BUTTER AT 52-55F, COOKED SALAMI AT 57F, COOKED PEPPERONI AT 57F, AND CUCUMBER RELISH AT 50F IN #2 TWO-DRAWER COOLER; OBSERVED COOKED POTATOES AT 44-46F AND CHICKEN WINGS AT 45-48F IN #3 TWO-DRAWER COOLER; OBSERVED SPINACH DIP AT 47F IN #6 TWO-DRAWER COOLER.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC DISCARDED OF ALL FOOD ITEMS DURING INSPECTION. PIC UNDERSTANDS ALL COLD HOLDING FOODS SHOULD BE KEPT AT 41F OR BELOW. PLEASE CONTINUE CORRECTION TO PREVENT FURTHER ENFORCEMENT ACTION. STONE'S COVE KITBAR (Inspection Date: 07/13/2026) Page 3 of 4

violations.title: Proper Thawing Methods for ROP Fish
violations.observation: OBSERVED THAWING COMMERCIALLY VACUUMED PACKAGED TUNA IN THE WALK-IN COOLER IN INTACT PACKAGING.
violations.corrective_action: PIC REMOVED FISH FROM PACKAGING DURING INSPECTION AND UNDERSTANDS THE TUNA NEEDS TO BE REMOVED FROM THE PACKAGING OR THE PACKAGING NEEDS TO BE SLIT OPEN WHEN THE THAWING PROCESS BEGINS. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED CORRECTION AND THAT ALL STAFF UNDERSTAND THIS PROCESS.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed the lack of an approved backflow prevention device on the water supply system. OBSERVED Y-SPLITTER INSTALLED AT THE THREE-VAT SINK.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. PIC REMOVED Y SPLITTER DURING INSPECTION. THE ESTABLISHMENT HAS AN APPROVED SPLITTER, BUT DID NOT INSTALL IT AS IT WAS LEAKING. PLEASE ENSURE IT IS PROPERLY INSTALLED IF THE ESTABLISHMENT WISHES TO HAVE TWO CONNECTIONS AT THE THREE-VAT SINK.
